projects.title: Port To Port Container Freight Solution
projects.excerpt: End-to-end container logistics handling for a major international trading firm.
projects.overview: We provided a complete port-to-port maritime freight solution for a large trading corporation needing regular shipments between Jakarta and Singapore.
projects.challenge: The client required strict scheduling and rapid customs clearance to meet tight distribution deadlines without incurring storage penalties.
projects.solution: We implemented an optimized booking strategy, pre-cleared documentation, and coordinated closely with port authorities on both sides.
projects.result: Delivered on schedule consistently for 6 months, reducing the client's transit delays by 35%.

projects.title: 250 Metric Ton Goods Freight For Manufacturer
projects.excerpt: Coordinating heavy transportation for industrial manufacturing equipment.
projects.overview: We successfully transported 250 metric tons of manufacturing equipment from a central distribution hub to a new factory site.
projects.challenge: The cargo was oversized and heavy, requiring special permits, route planning to avoid weak bridges, and coordinated escorts.
projects.solution: Our team deployed a fleet of heavy-duty flatbed trucks, secured all necessary permits, and surveyed the route in advance to ensure safety.
projects.result: All equipment arrived safely with zero damage, 2 days ahead of the projected schedule.

projects.title: Shipping Large Container From China To USA
projects.excerpt: Managing cross-Pacific freight for an electronics brand.
projects.overview: We managed the international shipping of consumer electronics from manufacturing plants in China to distribution centers in the USA.
projects.challenge: Navigating complex international customs regulations and ensuring high security for valuable electronic cargo.
projects.solution: Utilized secure container tracking, streamlined customs documentation, and partnered with reliable ocean carriers for prioritized handling.
projects.result: Achieved a 99.8% on-time delivery rate, ensuring the client's products hit the shelves for the holiday season.

projects.title: 200 Metric Ton Goods Freight For Mega Corp
projects.excerpt: Bulk material transportation via rail for a large corporate infrastructure project.
projects.overview: Facilitated the movement of 200 metric tons of construction materials using our train freight network.
projects.challenge: The client needed a highly cost-effective solution for a massive volume of goods that road transport could not efficiently support.
projects.solution: We arranged dedicated rail cars and coordinated seamless transfer from rail terminal to the construction site using our heavy trucks.
projects.result: Reduced transportation costs by 40% compared to exclusive road freight, while meeting all project timelines.

faqs.question: What is Bylian Logistic Transport Services?
faqs.answer: Bylian Logistic Transport Services is a professional logistics company providing integrated transportation, warehousing, cargo handling, and freight solutions for businesses requiring safe and efficient movement of goods globally.

faqs.question: Where is your company located?
faqs.answer: Our headquarters is located at Jl. Logistic Center No. 88, Jakarta, Indonesia. We operate across multiple domestic and international hubs.

faqs.question: What industries do you serve?
faqs.answer: We serve a wide range of industries including manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and construction.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to ship goods?
faqs.answer: Shipping costs depend on the service type, cargo weight, volume, and destination. We provide transparent pricing based on these factors.

faqs.question: Can I request a custom quote?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can request a custom quote via our 'Request a Quote' page, where you can provide specific details about your shipment needs.

faqs.question: What factors affect shipping cost?
faqs.answer: The main factors include the mode of transport (air, sea, land), distance, weight, dimensions, fuel surcharges, and any special handling requirements (like refrigeration).

faqs.question: What logistics services do you provide?
faqs.answer: We provide Land Freight, Maritime Freight, Train Freight, Air Cargo Support, Warehousing, and Last Mile Delivery.

faqs.question: Do you provide warehouse service?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer secure warehousing and inventory handling services for short-term and long-term storage.

faqs.question: Do you support last mile delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Last Mile Delivery service ensures that your goods are transported from distribution centers directly to the final customer efficiently.

faqs.question: What is the fastest goods transportation?
faqs.answer: Air Cargo Support is generally our fastest transportation method, ideal for urgent and time-sensitive shipments.

faqs.question: Can I track my shipment?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can use your Tracking ID on our 'Track Shipment' page to get real-time updates on your cargo's status.

faqs.question: What should I do if my tracking ID is not found?
faqs.answer: If your Tracking ID is not found, please ensure you entered it correctly. If the issue persists, contact our support team for assistance as it may take a few hours to appear in the system after booking.

faqs.question: How often is tracking updated?
faqs.answer: Tracking is updated at key milestones: upon pickup, arrival at hubs, departure from ports/airports, out for delivery, and upon final delivery.

faqs.question: Do you support international freight?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Maritime Freight and Air Cargo Support services cover extensive international routes.

faqs.question: Do you help with import/export documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team provides full assistance with customs clearance, import/export documentation, and regulatory compliance.

faqs.question: What cargo can be shipped internationally?
faqs.answer: We ship a variety of cargo including general goods, electronics, machinery, and textiles. However, hazardous materials and restricted items are subject to specific regulations.
